notes.character: The couch mark, rounded type, warm shared-living language, lime labels, and forest palette identify Kouchd clearly.
notes.hierarchy: Each onboarding screen has one dominant headline and one full-width primary action.
notes.typography: System rounded headings and native body styles remain readable without fashion-font dependencies.
notes.color: Light and dark palettes maintain clear separation between canvas, cards, labels, and actions.
notes.spacing: Cards and controls follow consistent 12, 20, and 24 point spacing without overlap.
notes.dark: Fresh light-to-dark regression screenshots retain pill and primary-button text after the foreground-style fix.
notes.states: First-run, role choice, authenticated fixtures, purchase handoff, and restore were reviewed; error and true offline states were not exercised in this pass.
notes.native: Controls use SwiftUI, SF Symbols, native navigation, 44-point targets, and swipe gestures.
notes.funnel: Onboarding and the intentional light RevenueCat paywall use the same forest, lime, rounded-card visual language.
notes.distinct: The shared-stay ledger and contribution language give the flow a recognizable product-specific character.
